svg.title: Vyukov MPMC — combined overview
svg.desc: A 2x2 combined SVG overview of four focused diagrams explaining Vyukov MPMC queue key ideas.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: The slot wraps. The position does not.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Modulo locates the slot; the full p identifies its turn.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Positions 0, 4, 8, ... reuse slot 0 but are NOT interchangeable.

svg.text: Same array element. Different logical generation.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Key invariant: compare slot.seq with the FULL logical position p, not with p % 4.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: One slot alternates who may claim it.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: slot.seq is the slot’s readiness + generation marker.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: After a write: seq = p + 1. After a read: seq = p + capacity.

svg.text: readable for that exact logical turn

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Example: seq=1 means data for p=0 is published; it does NOT mean writable for p=4.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Compare seq to the expected turn.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: A thread reads p, then asks whether that exact turn is ready.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Equal: try CAS. Behind: not ready. Ahead: retry.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: The same three-way test works for both sides, with different expected values.

svg.text: After equality, CAS can still fail: another peer claimed that position first.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: “Not ready” may mean full / empty OR an earlier operation has not published / freed yet.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: CAS reserves the position. A release store to seq hands off the slot.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Two handoffs: producer -> consumer -> next producer.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: The slot’s seq is atomic because both sides inspect and update it.
